description: The source describes Canadian Wheat Board wheat, barley and designated-barley payments in dollars per tonne on an Edmonton/Calgary basis, including deductions for freight, elevation and dockage removal. Two XLSX descriptors cover 2008–2009 through 2014–2015 and 2009–2010 through 2015–2016. The concrete logistics subject is freight and grain-elevator handling costs embedded in the payment tables. Total grain price is not treated as a transport cost. Exact routing, volume, tariff structure and individual deduction fields remain unverified. Overlapping releases are one collection, not separate resources. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source title, description and original Alberta identifiers. The record labels the material Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current file access and numerical contents are unverified. No linked document, workbook, archive, installer or data body was fetched. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless described above.
